verses.text: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: According to the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
verses.line: 1:Have mercy upon me O God according to thy lovingkindness According to the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions

verses.text: Wash me thoroughly from mine iniquity, And cleanse me from my sin.
verses.line: 2:Wash me thoroughly from mine iniquity And cleanse me from my sin

verses.text: For I know my transgressions; And my sin is ever before me.
verses.line: 3:For I know my transgressions And my sin is ever before me

verses.text: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, And done that which is evil in thy sight; That thou mayest be justified when thou speakest, And be clear when thou judgest.
verses.line: 4:Against thee thee only have I sinned And done that which is evil in thy sight That thou mayest be justified when thou speakest And be clear when thou judgest

verses.text: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity; And in sin did my mother conceive me.
verses.line: 5:Behold I was brought forth in iniquity And in sin did my mother conceive me

verses.text: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts; And in the hidden part thou wilt make me to know wisdom.
verses.line: 6:Behold thou desirest truth in the inward parts And in the hidden part thou wilt make me to know wisdom

verses.text: Purify me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: Wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
verses.line: 7:Purify me with hyssop and I shall be clean Wash me and I shall be whiter than snow

verses.text: Make me to hear joy and gladness, That the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.
verses.line: 8:Make me to hear joy and gladness That the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice

verses.text: Hide thy face from my sins, And blot out all mine iniquities.
verses.line: 9:Hide thy face from my sins And blot out all mine iniquities

verses.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God; And renew a right spirit within me.
verses.line: 10:Create in me a clean heart O God And renew a right spirit within me

verses.text: Cast me not away from thy presence; And take not thy holy Spirit from me.
verses.line: 11:Cast me not away from thy presence And take not thy holy Spirit from me

verses.text: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; And uphold me with a willing spirit.
verses.line: 12:Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation And uphold me with a willing spirit

verses.text: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; And sinners shall be converted unto thee.
verses.line: 13:Then will I teach transgressors thy ways And sinners shall be converted unto thee

verses.text: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation; And my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
verses.line: 14:Deliver me from bloodguiltiness O God thou God of my salvation And my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness

verses.text: O Lord, open thou my lips; And my mouth shall show forth thy praise.
verses.line: 15:O Lord open thou my lips And my mouth shall show forth thy praise

verses.text: For thou delightest not in sacrifice; else would I give it: Thou hast no pleasure in burnt-offering.
verses.line: 16:For thou delightest not in sacrifice else would I give it Thou hast no pleasure in burnt offering

verses.text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: A broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
verses.line: 17:The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit A broken and a contrite heart O God thou wilt not despise

verses.text: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: Build thou the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.line: 18:Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion Build thou the walls of Jerusalem

verses.text: Then wilt thou delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, In burnt-offering and whole burnt-offering: Then will they offer bullocks upon thine altar.
verses.line: 19:Then wilt thou delight in the sacrifices of righteousness In burnt offering and whole burnt offering Then will they offer bullocks upon thine altar
